Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this entertaining encounter and from New York as well as this was the last game of the World Cup here. India goes through to the next round while USA have it all to do in their last game. However, the action continues as we have a big clash coming up on 13th June, Thursday. It is West Indies taking on New Zealand and that game will begin at 6 am IST (12.30 am GMT), but as you know, you can always join us early for all the build-up to the match.  Until then, cheers and goodbye!

Rohit Sharma, the victorious skipper of India says they lost a couple of big guns early on but it was nice to see SKY and Dube keep their calm and build that partnership. Adds that they knew the bowlers will have to take the lead as scoring runs is difficult here. Appreciates the bowlers, especially Arshdeep Singh who bowled a brilliant spell and says he provided a perfect start for them. On being asked about Shivam Dube's bowling, he says they want options with the ball as well and to use them when they feel the need moving forward. Adds it is a big relief to advance to the Super 8s as playing here wasn't easy. Adds you really have to stick to the end and take the game as deep as possible and says luckily they have managed to pull through in all the three games they have played here. Also appreciates Suryakumar Yadav by saying that his game has also elevated to a new level now and that's exacty what he expects from a senior player like him. Ends up by saying that his partnership with Shivam Dube was a crucial one that took them home.

Aaron Jones, the captain of USA says that they were 10-15 runs short on this wicket. Adds that he is proud of his bowlers for taking the game close and it was pleasing to see. Mentions that it is time to revamp, they will have a few meetings and then will go hard against Ireland. Says that the wicket was tricky and he thought seamers were the best option. Ends by saying that Monank Patel should be fit for the next match.

Arshdeep Singh is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his career-best figures of (4-0-9-4). He begins by saying that he enjoyed and is very happy with the performance. Tells that the talk in the dressing room is to not provide easy balls to score as the batters will have to work hard to get those runs on a difficult wicket to bat on. On being asked about bowling at the death, he says he tries to bowl more yorkers and build pressure on the opposition batters and has learnt a lot from Jasprit Bumrah. Adds he tries to keep it simple and expects to perform well in the next phase of the tourament as well.
Presentation Time...

Earlier in the game, USA posted a fighting total on the board courtesy of a good knock from Nitish Kumar along with some contributions from Steven Taylor and Corey Anderson. Arshdeep Singh was sensational for India and ended up with a four-fer. Hardik Pandya picked up a couple while Axar Patel chipped in with one. While chasing, it was tricky for India losing the big guns early, but Suryakumar Yadav kept his calm and along with Shivam Dube took them over the line.

USA, on the other hand, should be pleased with their bowling effort as they made India work really hard for every run. Saurabh Netravalkar provided them a dream start by getting rid of Virat Kohli and then got Rohit Sharma as well. They couldn't pick up wickets for a while but checked the runs to keep the pressure on. Ali Khan came in and dismissed Rishabh Pant  with a magnificent delivery but they couldn't build on that. Saurabh Netravalkar also dropped SKY when the game was in the balance and that ultimately cost them in the end. USA were also penalised five penalty runs and that brought their morale further down as after that, the batters just took the game away from them.

India were rocked early on when Virat Kohli departed for a golden duck and then Rohit Sharma also fell cheaply. Rishabh Pant and Suryakumar Yadav steadied the ship nicely and build up an important partnership. The former was dismissed but SKY held one end, and even though Shivam Dube struggled, he did not gave his wicket away and supported well. SKY was also given a life and he made full use of it as he went to score an unbeaten half-century while Dube hit the winnings run and this is exactly what India would have wanted going into the next round.

HAT-TRICK OF WINS FOR INDIA! With that, they also book their place in the Super-8 stage as group winners. However, this was not easy as USA gave a tough fight with the ball. This is also the highest successful chase at this ground in this World Cup and it is all smiles in the Indian hut.

INDIA REGISTER THEIR THIRD WIN ON THE TROT AND MAINTAIN THE TRADITION OF REMAINING UNDEFEATED AGAINST ANY ASSOCIATE NATION! Ali Khan serves a half-volley on the stumps, Shivam Dube clears his front leg and smashes the ball down the ground with brute force. Steven Taylor runs in from long on and cuts the ball before the ropes but the batters run two and sail India through the winning line. And with this crucial win, India have advanced into the Super 8 stage of this ICC Men's T20 World Cup, 2024.

Commentary.Commentary: Goes back to his fuller length, on off, Rishabh Pant pushes it to extra covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Saurabh Netravalkar to Rishabh Pant, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and around off, Suryakumar Yadav steers it to third man for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Saurabh Netravalkar to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller and around off this time, Suryakumar Yadav keeps it out to the off side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Saurabh Netravalkar to Suryakumar Yadav, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on off, Suryakumar Yadav punches it through covers for a couple of runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Saurabh Netravalkar to Suryakumar Yadav, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! SKY at his best! Saurabh Netravalkar lands this on a good length, on middle, angling in, Suryakumar Yadav crouches low, uses his wrists well to scoop it away over the fine leg fence for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Saurabh Netravalkar to Suryakumar Yadav, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off, Suryakumar Yadav pushes it to short covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Saurabh Netravalkar to Suryakumar Yadav, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pulls his length back a bit, on middle, Rishabh Pant fends it out. Tidy over!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Jessy Singh to Rishabh Pant, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Another full delivery, on middle, Suryakumar Yadav tucks it away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Jessy Singh to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches it up, on middle, Suryakumar Yadav blocks it down the pitch.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Jessy Singh to Suryakumar Yadav, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on off, Rishabh Pant guides it to third man for another run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Jessy Singh to Rishabh Pant, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Full again and on middle, angling in, Suryakumar Yadav flicks it through square leg for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Jessy Singh to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Jessy Singh starts with a full delivery on the pads, Rishabh Pant clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Jessy Singh to Rishabh Pant, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Jessy Singh is introduced into the attack.
On a length and on off, Rishabh Pant runs it down to third man for one. End of another successful over from Saurabh Netravalkar!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Saurabh Netravalkar to Rishabh Pant, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Overpitched and outside off, Suryakumar Yadav slices it on the bounce to third man for a run and gets off the mark.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Saurabh Netravalkar to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Halt! The ball has stung Suryakumar Yadav's right wrist and the physio is out in no time to treat the hurt area with the magic spray. He is being strapped now and is all well to continue.
Hits the hard length this time, on middle, nips back in sharply, Suryakumar Yadav gets hurried a bit as the ball crashes onto his fingers. That will sting a bit!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Saurabh Netravalkar to Suryakumar Yadav, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up, on off, Suryakumar Yadav taps it to short covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Saurabh Netravalkar to Suryakumar Yadav, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Suryakumar Yadav is in at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! Saurabh Netravalkar strikes again! He gets the Indian skipper this time and USA are pumped here. This is full again and on off, shapes away a bit, Rohit Sharma tries to flick it away but closes the face of the bat early, gets a leading edge as the ball flies behind mid off where Harmeet Singh keeps his eyes on the ball, backtracks a bit and takes a fine catch. India lose both their openers now!
Commentary.Howout: c Harmeet Singh b Saurabh Netravalkar
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Saurabh Netravalkar to Rohit Sharma, OUT! c Harmeet Singh b Saurabh Netravalkar.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and around off, Rohit Sharma strides out and pushes it straight to short covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Saurabh Netravalkar to Rohit Sharma, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and outside off, Rohit Sharma cuts it away towards deep point for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Ali Khan to Rohit Sharma, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Another full delivery, on middle, Rohit Sharma blocks it out.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Ali Khan to Rohit Sharma, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up, on middle, Rishabh Pant tries to swat it past the bowler but fails to get the timing rigth as the ball rolls between mid on and mid off. They cross.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Ali Khan to Rishabh Pant, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller, on middle, keeps a bit low, Rohit Sharma manages well to get bat on that and knocks it to mid on for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Ali Khan to Rohit Sharma, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a good length and on middle, shaping in, Rishabh Pant misses his flick as the ball goes off his pads towards square leg. They cross.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Ali Khan to Rishabh Pant, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! You cannot bowl there to him! Ali Khan begins with a short delivery, outside off, Rishabh Pant gets the chance to free his arms, takes no half-meausres and crunches it over point for the first boundary of this chase.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Ali Khan to Rishabh Pant, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Ali Khan to bowl the second over.
Goes full again, on leg, Rishabh Pant flicks it away towards deep square leg for a single. Just two runs and a huge wicket from the first over!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Saurabh Netravalkar to Rishabh Pant, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches it up, on off, Rishabh Pant pushes it to short covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Saurabh Netravalkar to Rishabh Pant, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Oh...so close! Saurabh Netravalkar pulls his length back a bit, on off, nips back in sharply this time, Rishabh Pant gets squared up as he tries to play at it and misses, the ball just zips past the stumps.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Saurabh Netravalkar to Rishabh Pant, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Full again and on off, shaping away, Rishabh Pant steers it to point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Saurabh Netravalkar to Rishabh Pant, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Rishabh Pant is in at number 3.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! What a start for USA! Saurabh Netravalkar gets the big fish here as Virat Kohli walks back for a golden duck. This one is a bit fuller and just around off, angling away, Virat Kohli takes a half-stride and tries to drive away from his body, gets a thin outside edge behind where Andries Gous makes no mistake. Kohli's barren run in this World Cup continues!
Commentary.Howout: c Andries Gous b Saurabh Netravalkar
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Saurabh Netravalkar to Virat Kohli, OUT! c Andries Gous b Saurabh Netravalkar.

Commentary.Commentary: Rohit Sharma ​​​​and India are underway straightaway! Saurabh Netravalkar starts with a back-of-a-length delivery around off, Rohit Sharma guides it down to third man for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Saurabh Netravalkar to Rohit Sharma, 1 run.
